_about: Egress allowlist per agent job (docs/design/agent-pipeline.md section 13). Every runner job in the agent workflows runs harden-runner with egress-policy: block and exactly these hosts; host_tools/tests/test_egress.py keeps the workflows in step with this file. Measured from StepSecurity insights of audit runs 43424076285 (Builder), 43432797252 (Planner) and 43434610481 (Challenger) on 2026-11-13. The Inspector had no insights; its hosts are derived from the same steps in the Builder.

hosts.github.com:443: actions/checkout and git push over HTTPS; claude-code-action setup
hosts.api.github.com:443: gh CLI (labels, comments, pull requests), app tokens, claude-code-action
hosts.api.anthropic.com:443: Claude Code talks to the model
hosts.claude.ai:443: claude-code-action installs Claude Code from the official install script
hosts.downloads.claude.ai:443: the Claude Code binary the install script fetches
hosts.registry.npmjs.org:443: claude-code-action installs its own dependencies with bun
hosts.release-assets.githubusercontent.com:443: claude-code-action downloads bun from its GitHub release
hosts.azure.archive.ubuntu.com:80: apt-get install cppcheck (Ubuntu mirror of the Actions runner, plain HTTP, signed packages)
hosts.esm.ubuntu.com:443: apt-get update on the runner image (Ubuntu Pro source list)
hosts.packages.microsoft.com:443: apt-get update on the runner image (Microsoft source list)
